soft_regions.name: spring_active

selection.selector: Positive-depth exposed coil near upright: -0.36 < n.z < -0.17, 0.055 < n.x < 0.17, 0.012 < n.y < 0.095. Select coil-shaped component around an estimated line from A=[0.11,0.035,-0.335] to B=[0.14,0.035,-0.18], including its hooks but excluding straight support plate and knobs. Snap A/B to actual coil ends within this box using native geometry. Assign the other coil to upright as declared rigid_follow.
selection.reason: Visible metallic helix indicates elastic axial response, not a rigid rod; isolate one coil for bounded visible deformation.

axial_stiffness.reason: Effective spring assembly stiffness, not steel Young modulus; editable estimate.

mass.reason: Small metal spring assembly mass prior.

preview_extension.reason: Bounded visible nonrigid preview extension control; no physical load or recovery test.

stations.reason: Coarse flex cable stations; no fine coil remeshing.

soft_regions.reason: Build actual flex connectivity and dedicated native coil render binding. Fixed end attaches to upright A and moving end follows lower bracket B in its local frame. Use supported offset skin mapping around coarse centerline; preserve helical surface and UV/PBR at rest. Preview length change must deform coil spacing, not translate a rigid spring. test_strategy is a dormant contract field: user generation-only override forbids executing contact/load/unload or dynamics.

native_scale.reason: Approximate overall height 0.79 m per native unit; absolute size not observed.

interactions.name: assembly_controls
interactions.action: Expose independent finite preview controls. During construction only, evaluate actual owner hierarchy via static transforms at min/mid/max pose; this is visible attachment inspection, not endpoint testing or physical simulation.
interactions.expected: Descendant visible surfaces follow parent transformations; keep shared pin overlap, preserve open arm gaps and entire native shade. No physical success implied.

interactions.name: coil_control
interactions.action: Provide bounded extension parameter and native nonrigid skin binding; endpoints follow actual upright/lower frames during joint preview.
interactions.expected: Coil spacing visibly changes and returns under user parameter control; no load/recovery or material pass claim.

review_requirements: Construction integrity only: assign each native face exactly once to a rigid owner or spring_active; preserve its UV/material assignment and rest surface. Inspect ownership colors for complete paired bars, open gaps, shade shell/interior and coil versus upright/fasteners. Record local pivot/selector refinements; connectors only at evidenced bearing gaps under reviewed parent ownership, with total added area <=0.02 of native area and no removed native faces.

During preview construction only, inspect static transforms at minimum, middle and maximum declared finite travel for each of base_aim, shoulder_fold, elbow_fold and shade_aim, with other controls neutral. Confirm visible descendants follow, base stays fixed, transverse pins remain connected and the shade does not fragment. Use the stated child-local pivots and supported root-offset mapping. These are visual binding inspections, not simulated endpoint or collision tests; do not run mj_step or contact queries.

Create actual coarse cable connectivity and an exclusive nonempty native coil skin with supported offset binding. In static preview construction, show nonrigid change in coil spacing rather than rigid translation; preserve the rest helix and bind its ends to the actual upright and lower bracket frames, refining the coarse z cutoff at the moving attachment as needed. Label the secondary coil rigid_follow and expose any attachment gap. No force, load/unload or recovery test is authorized.

Save the complete GLB, editable Blender source, scene and interactive metadata early. Expose all four finite joint controls and the active coil parameter preview with their actual visible bindings and editable priors. Publish after construction with physics_status=not_tested and physics_attempts=0; do not create physical trajectories, test reports or physical-pass claims, and do not invoke simulation or full validation/critic loops.

interaction_coverage.label: Raise/lower and extend the light
interaction_coverage.reason: Two transverse pivot regions and separated arm spans support independent finite articulation. Start each with 90-degree travel about native rest.

interaction_coverage.label: Aim the shade
interaction_coverage.reason: Small transverse shade bracket visible in front/rear views supports local tilt.

interaction_coverage.label: Aim the arm around its foot
interaction_coverage.reason: Cylindrical upright-foot collar supports an estimated swivel; partially hidden bearing is an editable prior. Use finite +/-30-degree aiming, without asserting unlimited turns.

interaction_coverage.label: Extend and relax the visible coil
interaction_coverage.reason: Helical metal spring receives nonrigid preview binding; actual stiffness/recovery untested.

interaction_coverage.label: Additional coil response
interaction_coverage.reason: Preserve second coil on upright with unchanged geometry; secondary deformation deferred after one active coil is planned.

interaction_coverage.label: Support the assembly
interaction_coverage.reason: Fix the foot as a demonstration convention. Tabletop sliding/tipping is outside construction scope.

interaction_coverage.label: Possible friction knob adjustment
interaction_coverage.reason: Knob geometry alone does not establish a threaded locking travel or electrical function.
interaction_coverage.attempt_plan: Expose editable hinge friction/damping in preview metadata. Separate knob screw motion requires evidence of a thread/shaft and is not claimed.

deferred_compliance.name: spring_secondary
deferred_compliance.reason: Second visible coil retained on upright; additional independent deformation deferred while spring_active supplies the visible nonrigid attempt.

approximation_gaps.reason: Serial joint approximation groups parallel lower bars; does not recover exact parallelogram closure or hidden supports. Small pin additions are bounded; shade cavity remains native.
Use simple base cylinder, arm boxes/capsules and segmented shade-rim proxies; hollow shade interior and detailed spring contact are approximate. No contact tests or collision-free claim.
One coarse coil deformation is a parameter preview, not demonstrated elastic dynamics; second coil rigid_follow and counterbalance force accuracy remain gaps.
